name: KD Feature demo

triggers.name: == START & SAFETY
triggers.notes: What happens at power-on and in an emergency. Put the building's normal state in Startup: it also runs after a watchdog restart.

triggers.name: Startup
triggers.notes: Runs at every start (power on, restart, after saving). Starts the inloop after 5 s.

triggers.name: Emergency stop (in0)
triggers.notes: Machine Control input 0: the emergency-stop loop opens (24 V drops).

triggers.name: Mode -> Emergency
actions: email tech@example.com "Emergency stop" The emergency stop was pressed

triggers.name: == CLOCK & CALENDAR
triggers.notes: Opening hours. The Schedule page shows these in a month view and the next 7 days.

triggers.name: Morning start
actions: # wait for the projector before switching its input
wait until device "PJ left" is online timeout 120
triggers.notes: Weekdays 09:30 on opening days (calendar period Open: Tue-Sun), not on closed days (Schedule > Calendar).

triggers.name: Exterior lights
triggers.notes: A sub section: smaller heading, indented with its triggers.

triggers.name: Summer season (log)
actions: log Summer season: open longer today

triggers.name: Closed day starts
triggers.notes: Calendar change: fires just after midnight when the "Closed" period starts (or when a calendar edit starts it today).

triggers.name: == SHOW TASK LISTS
triggers.notes: Manual triggers = task lists that other triggers (buttons, UDP, clock) fire by name.

triggers.name: Start main show
actions: panel lbl_status text Show is running

triggers.name: Show: start video
triggers.notes: Fired by a ◆ trigger cue at 2 s on timeline "Main show". The brightsign event/var lines go through the KD plugin (kdlink) in the presentation.

triggers.name: Lobby: back to loop
triggers.notes: Plays a file directly in a BrightSign zone (KD plugin).

triggers.name: Lobby: show test pattern
triggers.notes: Plays the file of the presentation's "Testpattern" state in the Video zone (KD plugin); the presentation carries on when it ends.

triggers.name: Show: halfway
triggers.notes: Trigger cue at 30 s: shows the show-device commands.

triggers.name: Main show stopped early
triggers.notes: Timeline trigger "is released": fires on stop timeline, the ■ button, release all or another group-A timeline starting ({reason} says which), not when it reaches its end.

triggers.name: Any timeline paused
triggers.notes: Timeline 0 = any timeline; {timeline} is its number.

triggers.name: Flash walls once
triggers.notes: Used by "Flash walls 6x": {count} is the round.

triggers.name: Find the first fixtures
triggers.notes: Locate: fixtures 1-4 blink white for 8 s to find them in the room (also Fixtures / Map: Locate, or the L key). "locate off" stops it.

triggers.name: Relay chase
actions: repeat 4 times every 0.5 kissbox io 1.{i} on

triggers.name: Step through scenes
triggers.notes: Fired with repeat by the Teststand button: {count} = 1, 2, 3…

triggers.name: Winch up
triggers.notes: Only when the safety contact (in2) is closed.

triggers.name: == TOUCH PANEL
triggers.notes: Every kind of panel event: click, hold, double click, change (slider, dial, colour, XY, toggle).

triggers.name: CLICK Start show
triggers.notes: Visitor button: 30 s cooldown so pressing it again does nothing.

triggers.name: HOLD All off (3 s)
actions: log All off by long press

triggers.name: DOUBLE Blackout
actions: if var blackout = on then blackout off else blackout on

triggers.name: Fog toggle
actions: if var fog_on = on then io Fog on else io Fog off

triggers.name: Hall projectors mute
triggers.notes: Projector group "hall" (Devices > Projectors): one command for both hall projectors.

triggers.name: CLICK Teststand
actions: repeat trigger "Step through scenes" every 2 times 6

triggers.name: HOLD Service mode (5 s)
triggers.notes: Hold the Service button on the Technician page for 5 s.

triggers.name: == EXTERNAL CONTROL
triggers.notes: UDP, OSC, TCP, HTTP, Art-Net/sACN in, DMX change.

triggers.name: UDP SHOW <name>
actions: log UDP asked for show {1} from {sender_ip}
if var visitors >= 0 then fire trigger "Start main show"

triggers.name: OSC fader -> grand master
triggers.notes: A TouchOSC fader sending 0-100. "Latest value only": at most 40 runs a second, with the newest value.

triggers.name: Visitor counted (UDP)
actions: if var visitors >= 50 then panel lbl_status text FULL ({visitors})

triggers.name: Media server status
actions: if var media_status != {status} then var media_status = {status}

triggers.name: Desk ch1 >= 50 %: start show
triggers.notes: Mock console: dmxin artnet 0 1 255

triggers.name: == DEVICES & MONITORING
triggers.notes: Device online/offline, projector alarms, PLC, KNX and Machine Control readings.

triggers.name: Lamp hours 4000
actions: email tech@example.com "{projector} lamp" Lamp passed {hours} h (now {lamp} h)
triggers.notes: Mock console: projector "PJ left" send LAMP=4100

triggers.name: Door opened (PLC)
actions: if mode Museum is Open then log Door opened during opening hours else email tech@example.com "Door" Door opened outside opening hours

triggers.name: Visitor sensor (in1)
triggers.notes: Only counts while the museum is open (Only active in).

triggers.name: Museum open
triggers.notes: "Starting up" goes to Open by itself after 120 s (its actions on the Modes page); this skips the wait.

triggers.name: Emergency over
triggers.notes: Back to the state System was in before the emergency.

triggers.name: Long maintenance reminder
actions: email tech@example.com "Maintenance" System has been in maintenance for over 2 hours

triggers.name: == EXAMPLES
triggers.notes: Disabled triggers and comment lines.

triggers.name: Disabled example
actions: # a line starting with # is a comment and is skipped
log This trigger is switched off

triggers.name: Weekend check every 20 s
triggers.notes: Fires every 20 s. On weekdays its condition is false: the row flashes red instead of orange, the diamond in Show flow flashes red and the fire history says "condition false".

effects.name: Rainbow
effects.code:
// Colour wheel rolling over the fixtures
param speed = 0.2 [0, 2]       // turns of the colour wheel per second
param spread = 1 [0, 4]        // rainbows across the rig (the map's width): 0 = all the same colour
param sat = 1 [0, 1]           // saturation: 0 = white, 1 = full colour
r, g, b = hsv(t * speed + x * spread, sat, 1)

effects.name: Chase
effects.code:
// One light running along the fixtures, in list order
param speed = 0.5 [0, 4]       // rounds per second: 1 = the light passes every fixture once a second
param width = 0.25 [0.02, 1]   // size of the light, part of the rig (0.25 = a quarter)
param color = #ffffff          // colour of the light
param back = #000000           // colour of the other fixtures
pos = fract(t * speed)
d = abs(fract(u - pos + 0.5) - 0.5)
k = smoothstep(max(width / 2, 1 / n), 0, d)
r = mix(back.r, color.r, k)
g = mix(back.g, color.g, k)
b = mix(back.b, color.b, k)

effects.name: Bounce (scanner)
effects.code:
// A light going back and forth along the fixtures
param speed = 0.3 [0, 4]       // trips there and back per second
param width = 0.2 [0.02, 1]    // size of the light, part of the rig
param color = #ff0000          // colour of the light
p0 = n > 1 ? i / (n - 1) : 0.5
d = abs(p0 - tri(t * speed))
r, g, b = color
dim = smoothstep(max(width / 2, 1 / n), 0, d)

effects.name: Theatre chase
effects.code:
// Every few fixtures on, stepping along (marquee lights)
param rate = 4 [0.5, 20]       // steps per second
param every = 3 [2, 8]         // one fixture on in every ... fixtures
param color = #ffcc66          // colour of the fixtures that are on
param back = #000000           // colour of the others
on = mod(i - floor(t * rate), max(floor(every), 2)) < 1
r = on ? color.r : back.r
g = on ? color.g : back.g
b = on ? color.b : back.b

effects.name: Two-colour fade
effects.code:
// Fade back and forth between two colours, offset per fixture
param speed = 0.15 [0, 2]      // fades there and back per second
param offset = 0.5 [0, 1]      // shift along the rig: 0 = all together, 1 = a whole cycle spread out
param a = #ff2d92              // first colour
param b2 = #0a84ff             // second colour
k = tri(t * speed + u * offset)
r = mix(a.r, b2.r, k)
g = mix(a.g, b2.g, k)
b = mix(a.b, b2.b, k)

effects.name: Colour steps
effects.code:
// Steps through three colours
param rate = 0.5 [0.05, 4]     // colour changes per second
param fade = 0.3 [0, 1]        // 0 = hard cut, 1 = fade all the way to the next colour
param offset = 0 [0, 1]        // shift along the rig: 0 = all fixtures the same colour
param c1 = #ff0000             // first colour
param c2 = #00ff00             // second colour
param c3 = #0000ff             // third colour
ph = mod(t * rate + u * offset * 3, 3)
st = floor(ph)
k = smoothstep(1 - fade, 1, fract(ph))
r = mix(st < 1 ? c1.r : st < 2 ? c2.r : c3.r, st < 1 ? c2.r : st < 2 ? c3.r : c1.r, k)
g = mix(st < 1 ? c1.g : st < 2 ? c2.g : c3.g, st < 1 ? c2.g : st < 2 ? c3.g : c1.g, k)
b = mix(st < 1 ? c1.b : st < 2 ? c2.b : c3.b, st < 1 ? c2.b : st < 2 ? c3.b : c1.b, k)

effects.name: Wipe
effects.code:
// Fills the rig with a colour from left to right, then empties it the same way
param speed = 0.25 [0.02, 2]   // complete fill + empty cycles per second
param soft = 0.1 [0, 0.5]      // soft edge, part of the rig (0 = hard edge)
param color = #0a84ff          // fill colour
param back = #000000           // colour before the fill
e = fract(t * speed * 2) * (1 + soft) - soft
fill = 1 - smoothstep(e, e + soft, x)
k = fract(t * speed) < 0.5 ? fill : 1 - fill
r = mix(back.r, color.r, k)
g = mix(back.g, color.g, k)
b = mix(back.b, color.b, k)

effects.name: Police
effects.code:
// Red / blue alternating halves
param rate = 2 [0.5, 8]        // changes per second
side = u < 0.5
phase = sq(t * rate)
on = side ? phase : 1 - phase
r = on
b = 1 - on
dim = pulse(t * rate * 4, 0.5) * 0.5 + 0.5

effects.name: Breathe
effects.code:
// Slow fade up and down
param speed = 0.25 [0.02, 2]   // breaths per second
param low = 0.1 [0, 1]         // lowest level (0 = all the way off)
param color = #ffb347          // colour
r, g, b = color
dim = mix(low, 1, 0.5 - 0.5 * cos(t * speed * tau))

effects.name: Heartbeat
effects.code:
// Double pulse, like a heartbeat
param bpm = 60 [20, 180]       // beats per minute
param low = 0.05 [0, 0.5]      // level between the beats
param color = #ff2040          // colour
ph = fract(t * bpm / 60)
beat = max(1 - abs(ph - 0.08) * 14, 0) + 0.7 * max(1 - abs(ph - 0.3) * 12, 0)
r, g, b = color
dim = mix(low, 1, min(beat, 1))

effects.name: Strobe
effects.code:
// Flashes; rate in flashes per second
param rate = 8 [0.5, 25]       // flashes per second
param duty = 0.15 [0.02, 0.9]  // part of each flash that is on (0.5 = half on, half off)
param color = #ffffff          // colour of the flash
r, g, b = color
dim = pulse(t * rate, duty)

effects.name: Lightning
effects.code:
// Random lightning flashes over the whole rig
param rate = 0.5 [0.05, 4]     // flashes per second, on average
param base = 0 [0, 0.3]        // level between the flashes
param color = #dfe8ff          // colour of the flash
s = floor(t * 20)
hit = rand(s * 0.0137) < rate / 20
r, g, b = color
dim = hit ? 0.4 + 0.6 * rand(s * 0.0291 + 0.5) : base

effects.name: Fire
effects.code:
// Flickering flame, every fixture its own
param speed = 3 [0.5, 10]      // how fast the flames flicker
f = noise(t * speed + i * 17.3) * 0.7 + noise(t * speed * 2.7 + i * 5.1) * 0.3
r = 1
g = 0.25 + f * 0.35
b = 0
dim = 0.35 + f * 0.65

effects.name: Candle
effects.code:
// Warm, gentle flicker
param color = #ff9329          // colour of the flame
f = noise(t * 2.1 + i * 3.7) * 0.6 + noise(t * 7.3 + i) * 0.4
r, g, b = color
dim = 0.6 + f * 0.4

effects.name: Sparkle
effects.code:
// Random short flashes on a coloured base
param rate = 6 [1, 30]         // chances to flash per second
param chance = 0.08 [0, 0.5]   // part of the fixtures that flash each time
param base = #1a2a6c           // background colour
param flash = #ffffff          // colour of the flash
step_t = floor(t * rate)
on = rand(step_t * 0.37 + i * 0.011) < chance
r = on ? flash.r : base.r
g = on ? flash.g : base.g
b = on ? flash.b : base.b

effects.name: Twinkle
effects.code:
// Every fixture slowly fades in and out on its own (starry sky)
param speed = 0.3 [0.05, 2]    // how fast the stars fade in and out
param amount = 0.45 [0, 1]     // how many stars are lit at a time
param color = #ffffff          // colour of the stars
param base = #000814           // background colour
k = smoothstep(1 - amount, 1, noise(t * speed + i * 7.31))
r = mix(base.r, color.r, k)
g = mix(base.g, color.g, k)
b = mix(base.b, color.b, k)

effects.name: Wave across the map
effects.code:
// Brightness wave moving left to right over the map
param speed = 0.3 [0, 2]       // waves passing per second
param size = 1.5 [0.2, 6]      // waves across the map's width
param color = #00c7be          // colour
r, g, b = color
dim = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin((x * size - t * speed) * tau)

effects.name: XY ripple
effects.code:
// Rings rippling out from a point on the map, like a stone in water
param cx = 0.5 [0, 1]          // centre: 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge
param cy = 0.5 [0, 1]          // centre: 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge
param speed = 0.5 [0, 3]       // rings per second
param size = 3 [0.5, 10]       // rings from the centre to the edge
param color = #00c7be          // colour of the rings
param back = #000000           // colour between the rings
d = sqrt((x - cx) * (x - cx) + (y - cy) * (y - cy))
k = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin((d * size - t * speed) * tau), 3)
r = mix(back.r, color.r, k)
g = mix(back.g, color.g, k)
b = mix(back.b, color.b, k)

effects.name: XY sweep
effects.code:
// A bar of light sweeping over the map, in any direction
param angle = 0 [0, 360]       // direction in degrees: 0 = to the right, 90 = down, 180 = to the left
param speed = 0.3 [0, 2]       // sweeps per second
param width = 0.2 [0.02, 1]    // thickness of the bar, part of the map
param color = #ffffff          // colour of the bar
a = angle / 360 * tau
p = (x - 0.5) * cos(a) + (y - 0.5) * sin(a)
pos = fract(t * speed) * (1.42 + width) - 0.71 - width / 2
r, g, b = color
dim = smoothstep(width / 2, 0, abs(p - pos))

effects.name: XY radar
effects.code:
// A beam turning around a point, with a fading tail
param cx = 0.5 [0, 1]          // centre: 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge
param cy = 0.5 [0, 1]          // centre: 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge
param speed = 0.25 [-2, 2]     // turns per second (minus = the other way round)
param tail = 0.3 [0.02, 1]     // length of the tail, part of a turn
param color = #30d158          // colour of the beam
a = atan(y - cy, x - cx) / tau
k = speed >= 0 ? fract(t * speed - a) : fract(a - t * speed)
r, g, b = color
dim = smoothstep(tail, 0, k)

effects.name: XY plasma
effects.code:
// Soft colour clouds drifting over the map
param speed = 0.3 [0, 2]       // how fast the clouds move
param scale = 3 [0.5, 10]      // bigger = more, smaller clouds
param sat = 1 [0, 1]           // saturation: 0 = white, 1 = full colour
v = sin(x * scale * 3 + t * speed * 3) + sin((y * scale + t * speed * 2) * 2) + sin((x + y) * scale * 2 - t * speed * 4)
r, g, b = hsv(v / 6 + t * speed * 0.2, sat, 1)

effects.name: XY gradient
effects.code:
// Two colours blended across the map at an angle, optionally moving
param angle = 0 [0, 360]       // direction of the blend in degrees: 0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom
param speed = 0 [-1, 1]        // how fast the colours move (0 = still)
param c1 = #ff2d92             // colour at the start
param c2 = #0a84ff             // colour at the end
a = angle / 360 * tau
p = (x - 0.5) * cos(a) + (y - 0.5) * sin(a) + 0.5
k = tri((p + t * speed) / 2)
r = mix(c1.r, c2.r, k)
g = mix(c1.g, c2.g, k)
b = mix(c1.b, c2.b, k)

effects.name: XY ripple (stretched)
effects.code:
// Rings rippling out from a point on the map, like a stone in water
param cx = 0.5 [0, 1]          // centre: 0 = left edge, 1 = right edge
param cy = 0.5 [0, 1]          // centre: 0 = top edge, 1 = bottom edge
param speed = 0.5 [0, 3]       // rings per second
param size = 3 [0.5, 10]       // rings from the centre to the edge
param color = #00c7be          // colour of the rings
param back = #000000           // colour between the rings
d = sqrt((x - cx) * (x - cx) + (y - cy) * (y - cy))
k = pow(0.5 + 0.5 * sin((d * size - t * speed) * tau), 3)
r = mix(back.r, color.r, k)
g = mix(back.g, color.g, k)
b = mix(back.b, color.b, k)

effects.name: Vitrine shimmer (own)
effects.code:
// Our own effect: a slow warm shimmer for the showcase
param speed = 0.3 [0, 2]       // shimmer waves per second
param color = #ffb070          // base colour
param depth = 0.4 [0, 1]       // how deep the shimmer dips
k = 1 - depth * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin((u * 2 + t * speed) * tau))
r, g, b = color
dim = k * (0.8 + 0.2 * noise(t * 3 + i))
